entities.summary: Rhys Patchell is a retired Welsh international rugby union player. A fly-half, he played for the Highlanders in Super Rugby, having previously played for the Scarlets and Cardiff Blues. Patchell represented Wales on 22 occasions between 2013 and 2023.
